task.name: direct_sorting
task.instruction: Sort the red cubes into the red tray and the blue cubes into the blue tray.
task.source: external dual-SO101 MuJoCo project, scripted physical expert

state.timing: measured joint state immediately before the action is issued

action.semantics: absolute joint-position target, left six then right six
action.label_rule: clamped actuator target actually applied at that control frame; never the next measured state

collection.attempt_budget_provenance: 31.3% of certified draws meet the registered 0.08 m separation, so ~193 executed layouts are expected for 60 successes; the pool leaves headroom for expert failures and the ceiling is a hard stop

measured_expert_wall_clock.note: measured on the certified snapshot with the layout filter active; the historical 823 s/episode figure included perturbation replays and does not apply
measured_expert_wall_clock.amendment: measured after 21 attempts / 6 successes (mean 208.9 s per success, 15 zero-cost layout rejects) gives ~43,900 s projected for 60 successes; the first 28,800 s ceiling was raised to 51,840 s with a registered watchdog on this round's own collection pid

split.rule: 60 independently successful scenes in collection order; first 48 train, last 12 validation; freeze before training

collection.success_predicate: external SortingTask.evaluate: tray geometry, support/contact, robot clearance, velocity and sustained stability
collection.failure_policy: every attempt and failure reason is kept; a failed attempt never becomes a demonstration

evaluation.purpose: reserved independent clean-layout scenes; no learned-policy rollout in this round
evaluation.scene_freeze: SceneSpec and SHA-256 written before any policy rollout
evaluation.success_predicate: external SortingTask.evaluate, independent of the policy
evaluation.report: success count / 20 with Wilson 95% interval and failure categories

claims.engineering_chain: 60 clean spread-layout scripted-expert demonstrations -> audited train-only statistics -> 25000 JAX LoRA updates

scene_layout.minimum_distance_provenance: measured by runs/so101/clean60_layout_pilot_wide_* (520 certified sampler draws, public summary reports/so101-clean60-layout-pilot.md): >=0.12 m occurred in 1/400 draws, >=0.10 in 4.75%, >=0.08 in 31.3%; the draft 0.12 m is rejected as unachievable inside the certified sampling region
scene_layout.sampling_region: unchanged certified pick regions and IK certificate; no region widening, no guard relaxation
scene_layout.boundary_margin_m: as certified by the external sampler's own region and clearance checks
scene_layout.method: reject certified direct scenes whose minimum pairwise cube-centre distance is below the registered minimum before any physical execution
scene_layout.reachable: external certified pick regions plus per-scene grasp and hover IK; every admitted episode must complete physical sorting and replay
